A restored backup follows the same rule, and Start today over is off while this is on.

target: Setelan ini tidak tersedia. Cari setelan lain.

source: Take HushPine out of PineDrama's Settings and privacy. To open these settings, press and hold any tab at the top of the feed.
target: Keluarkan HushPine dari Pengaturan dan privasi PineDrama. Untuk membuka pengaturan ini, tekan lama tab mana pun di bagian atas feed.

source: Search didn't open. Restart PineDrama and try again.
target: Pencarian tak terbuka. Mulai ulang PineDrama, coba lagi.

source: Lock the feed at set times

The feed locks by itself during these hours, on your phone's clock. Write days and hours like Mon-Fri 21:00-07:00; Sat Sun 13:00-15:00. Leave the days out for every day. A time that ends earlier than it starts runs past midnight.
target: Feed terkunci sendiri selama jam-jam ini, menurut jam ponselmu. Tulis hari dan jam seperti Mon-Fri 21:00-07:00; Sat Sun 13:00-15:00. Kosongkan hari agar berlaku setiap hari. Waktu yang berakhir lebih awal dari mulainya berlanjut melewati tengah malam.

source: Couldn't read %1$s. Write days and hours like Mon-Fri 21:00-07:00.
target: Tidak dapat membaca %1$s. Tulis hari dan jam seperti Mon-Fri 21:00-07:00.

source: %1$s starts and ends at the same time. Give it a different end time.
target: %1$s mulai dan berakhir pada waktu yang sama. Beri waktu selesai yang berbeda.

source: Saves wait for Wi-Fi or another network that isn't metered, for up to 30 minutes, and stop if you leave it. Saving a frame still works anywhere.
target: Penyimpanan menunggu Wi-Fi atau jaringan lain yang tidak berkuota hingga 30 menit, dan berhenti jika kamu keluar darinya. Menyimpan bingkai tetap bisa di mana saja.

source: The last one is still waiting for Wi-Fi
No Wi-Fi for 30 minutes. Save again on Wi-Fi.
target: Tak ada Wi-Fi 30 menit. Simpan lagi lewat Wi-Fi.

source: Saved %1$s of %2$s. Save the rest on Wi-Fi.
target: Tersimpan %1$s dari %2$s. Simpan sisanya lewat Wi-Fi.

source: Save stopped when Wi-Fi dropped. Retry on Wi-Fi.
target: Simpan berhenti saat Wi-Fi putus. Ulangi lewat Wi-Fi.

source: Zero switches this off. After that many minutes with no touch on the screen, the video stops and PineDrama goes to the background, for when you fall asleep watching. Any touch starts the wait over.
target: Nol mematikan ini. Setelah sekian menit layar tidak disentuh, video berhenti dan PineDrama pindah ke latar belakang, untuk saat kamu tertidur sambil menonton. Sentuhan apa pun memulai ulang waktu tunggu.

source: Make a sticker from a photo
Couldn't open your photos. Try again.
target: Tidak bisa membuka fotomu. Coba lagi.

source: Couldn't make the sticker. Try again.
target: Tidak bisa membuat stiker. Coba lagi.

source: Couldn't read that photo. Try another one.
target: Gagal membaca foto itu. Coba foto lain.
Akun ini tidak bisa membuat stiker

source: Keep your place in History and Favorites
target: Pertahankan posisi di Riwayat dan Favorit

source: Stops these lists jumping back to the top when you switch tabs or come back from a video. A list you haven't scrolled still updates.
target: Mencegah daftar ini melompat ke atas saat Anda berganti tab atau kembali dari video. Daftar yang belum Anda gulir tetap diperbarui.

source: Swipe up for the next episode and down for the previous one without leaving full screen. The next episode starts when one ends, instead of the same one looping.
target: Geser ke atas untuk episode berikutnya dan ke bawah untuk episode sebelumnya tanpa keluar dari layar penuh. Saat episode berakhir, episode berikutnya dimulai, bukan mengulang yang sama.

source: Language codes in the order you want them, separated by commas, like en, original. original means the video's own subtitle. Used when a video starts playing.
target: Kode bahasa sesuai urutan yang Anda mau, dipisahkan koma, seperti en, original. original berarti subtitel asli video. Dipakai saat video mulai diputar.

source: Always use the first subtitle on your list that a video has, even with captions off. A video with none of them plays as usual. Turning captions off yourself lasts until the app restarts.
target: Selalu pakai subtitel pertama di daftar Anda yang dimiliki video, meski teks nonaktif. Video tanpa subtitel itu diputar seperti biasa. Jika Anda mematikan teks sendiri, itu berlaku sampai aplikasi dimulai ulang.

source: Always use the video's own subtitle, never a translated one, even with captions off. A video without one plays as usual.
target: Selalu pakai subtitel asli video, bukan terjemahan, meski teks nonaktif. Video tanpa subtitel asli diputar seperti biasa.

source: Language codes in the order you want them, separated by commas, like en, original. original means the video's own audio. Used when a video starts playing.
target: Kode bahasa sesuai urutan yang Anda mau, dipisahkan koma, seperti en, original. original berarti audio asli video. Dipakai saat video mulai diputar.

source: Always use the first dub on your list that a video has, even with dubbing off. A video with none of them plays as usual.
target: Selalu pakai sulih suara pertama di daftar Anda yang dimiliki video, meski sulih suara nonaktif. Video tanpa sulih suara itu diputar seperti biasa.

source: Always play the video's own audio, never an AI dub.
target: Selalu putar audio asli video, bukan sulih suara AI.

source: Hide videos without a preferred subtitle

Hides videos with no subtitle from Subtitle priority in Playback, and that includes videos with no subtitles at all. If a whole page would be hidden, one video stays so the feed keeps loading. Does nothing while the list is empty.
target: Menyembunyikan video tanpa subtitel dari Prioritas subtitel di Pemutaran, termasuk video tanpa subtitel sama sekali. Jika seluruh halaman akan tersembunyi, satu video tetap ada agar feed terus dimuat. Tidak berpengaruh selama daftar kosong.

source: Hide videos without a preferred dub
target: Sembunyikan video tanpa sulih suara pilihan

source: Hides videos with no dub from Dub priority in Playback. Putting original on that list keeps every video, since each has its own audio. If a whole page would be hidden, one video stays so the feed keeps loading. Does nothing while the list is empty.
target: Menyembunyikan video tanpa sulih suara dari Prioritas sulih suara di Pemutaran. Menaruh original di daftar itu mempertahankan semua video, karena tiap video punya audio sendiri. Jika seluruh halaman akan tersembunyi, satu video tetap ada agar feed terus dimuat. Tidak berpengaruh selama daftar kosong.

source: PineDrama sometimes starts on Discover, like in the first days after an install. This starts it on Home instead.
target: PineDrama kadang terbuka di Jelajahi, misalnya pada hari-hari pertama setelah dipasang. Ini membukanya di Beranda.
